title: JCI Metasys protected server — declared guide baseline
document: Metasys Release 16.0 Secure Deployment Guide Rev A FINAL

statements.statement: The guide recommends protected access rather than direct internet exposure. Applicability to this installation is unconfirmed; investigate routes or bindings that bypass the intended protection.
statements.reference: Section 1.3.1; confirm the applicable product version and deployment profile

statements.statement: Ports 9505 (rate limiting), 9506 (API rewriting) and 9507 (internal API) are classified as internal-only in the guide. This classification does not establish effective listener, proxy or firewall enforcement.
statements.reference: Table 1.6.1.2, Internal Only Port numbers and protocols, printed page 31
